lastCompletedStory.title: Refuse a blank or non-string acceptance criterion at filing time

nextStoryContext: validateSpec now rejects any acceptanceCriteria element that is not a non-empty (post-trim) string, reusing the existing module-private isNonEmptyString helper (src/issues/spec.ts:60) per element via Array.prototype.every. The array-level checks (missing/non-array/empty) are unchanged and still short-circuit before the new element-level check runs. Both existing callers (validateSpecGuardrail in src/commands/issue-file.ts:219, and the spec interview in src/commands/issue-specify.ts:332) get the stricter behavior for free with no call-site changes. Regression fixtures in test/issue-file.test.ts and test/integration/issue-file-spec-channel.test.ts (real-string criteria) were unaffected. No follow-up needed.
